description: Pure Simplex HTTP server and client library with async support, routing, middleware, SSE, CORS, and JSON handling.

modules.name: lib
modules.description: Root module and re-exports for simplex-http.

modules.name: server
modules.description: Async HTTP server with io_uring support, configurable workers, keep-alive, and request size limits.

items.name: ServerConfig
items.signature: pub struct ServerConfig { pub host: String, pub port: u16, pub max_connections: usize, pub read_timeout_ms: u64, pub write_timeout_ms: u64, pub keep_alive: bool, pub max_request_size: usize, pub workers: usize }

items.name: ServerConfig::host
items.signature: pub fn host(mut self, host: &str) -> Self

items.name: ServerConfig::port
items.signature: pub fn port(mut self, port: u16) -> Self

items.name: ServerConfig::workers
items.signature: pub fn workers(mut self, workers: usize) -> Self

modules.name: client
modules.description: Async HTTP client with redirect following, configurable timeouts, and default headers.

items.name: ClientConfig
items.signature: pub struct ClientConfig { pub timeout_ms: u64, pub follow_redirects: bool, pub max_redirects: u32, pub user_agent: String }

items.name: HttpClient::header
items.signature: pub fn header(mut self, key: &str, value: &str) -> Self

modules.name: request
modules.description: HTTP request types including Method, Headers, and Query parsing.

items.name: Method
items.signature: pub enum Method { GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS }

modules.name: response
modules.description: HTTP response types including StatusCode and cookie management.

modules.name: router
modules.description: URL routing with pattern matching, path parameters, and handler registration.

modules.name: middleware
modules.description: Composable middleware chain with logging, compression, rate limiting, timeouts, and security headers.

modules.name: cors
modules.description: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) configuration and middleware.

modules.name: json
modules.description: JSON serialization and deserialization for HTTP request/response bodies.
